vr1019116.title: Brighte ELEKI LIFT BRT-FL170 EMS Facial Lift Beauty Device Mocha Brown
vr1019116.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vr1019116.details: Brighte ELEKI LIFT BRT-FL170 handheld EMS facial care device in Mocha Brown, brand new. It has 3 modes, CLEAN, LIFT and HEAT, and is charged with the included USB-C cable. Charging takes about 3 hours and the usable time is about 45 to 300 minutes depending on the mode. Size about 4.6 x 16.9 x 3.5 cm, weight about 137 g. It supports 100-240V charging for use at home and abroad; no wall adapter is included. Not for people with a pacemaker or other implanted medical device; please follow the manufacturer's instructions. The photo is a product image.
vr1019116.why: A new Brighte ELEKI LIFT BRT-FL170 EMS facial device in Mocha Brown.
vr1019116.perfect: Beauty device fans who want a compact, rechargeable EMS facial care device.
vr1019116.exp: A brand new Brighte ELEKI LIFT BRT-FL170 in Mocha Brown in the condition described above.
vr1019116.cd: Brand new. The photo is a product image. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
